# College Football Data

CollegeFootballData.com provides comprehensive college football data, including game scores, statistics, and recruiting information, accessible via a RESTful API.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/college-football-data/.

## Actions

- **Advanced Box Score** (read-only): Retrieve advanced box score metrics for a single college football game.
- **Advanced Game Stats** (read-only): Retrieve advanced team metrics at the game level.
- **Advanced Season Stats by Team** (read-only): Retrieve advanced season metrics aggregated by team and season.
- **Betting Lines** (read-only): Fetch betting lines and totals by game and provider.
- **Elo Ratings** (read-only): Retrieve Elo ratings for college football teams.
- **Get Games and Results** (read-only): Retrieve games and results for a given season/week/team.
- **Get Player Game Stats** (read-only): Fetch player statistics at the game level.
- **Get Team Game Stats** (read-only): Fetch team statistics at the game level.
- **Get Team Roster** (read-only): Fetch roster for a given team and season.
- **List FBS Teams** (read-only): List FBS teams for a given season.
- **List FCS Teams** (read-only): List FCS teams for a given season and conference.
- **List Teams** (read-only): List college football teams.
- **NFL Draft Picks** (read-only): List NFL Draft picks.
- **Play-by-Play Data** (read-only): Fetch play-by-play data for college football games.
- **Rankings Polls** (read-only): Retrieve weekly human/computer poll rankings.
- **Season Stats Player** (read-only): Fetch basic season stats aggregated by player and season.
- **Season Team Stats** (read-only): Get basic season stats aggregated by team and season.
- **SP+ Ratings** (read-only): Retrieve SP+ team ratings.
- **SRS Ratings** (read-only): Retrieve Simple Rating System (SRS) team ratings.
- **Team Matchup History** (read-only): Retrieve head-to-head team matchup records over a date range.
- **Team season records** (read-only): Fetch team season records by year with optional filters.
- **Composite Team Talent** (read-only): Fetch composite team talent rankings by season.
- **Conference Memberships History** (read-only): Retrieve historical conference memberships for teams, including years active and division.
- **Divisions by Conference** (read-only): List FBS/FCS conference divisions with active years and metadata.
- **Get Drive Data** (read-only): Retrieve drive-level data and results.
- **Get Game Media** (read-only): Retrieve game media information and broadcast schedules (TV, radio, web, etc.).
- **List Coaches and History** (read-only): Get coaching records and history.
- **List Conferences** (read-only): List all college football conferences.
- **List Venues and Stadiums** (read-only): List college football venues with metadata (name, capacity, location, etc.).
- **NFL Draft Positions** (read-only): List NFL draft positions.
- **NFL Draft Teams** (read-only): List NFL teams used in draft endpoints.
- **Play Stat Types** (read-only): Fetch all play-level stat type definitions.
- **Play Stats Player** (read-only): Fetch player-level stats tied to individual plays.
- **Player PPA by Game** (read-only): Retrieve player-level PPA/EPA broken down by game.
- **PPA Player By Season** (read-only): Fetch player-level PPA/EPA aggregated by season.
- **PPA Team By Game**: Retrieve team Predicted Points Added (PPA) by game.
- **Predict Expected Points (EP)** (read-only): Get expected points by down, distance, and field position.
- **Recruiting Group Dictionary** (read-only): List recruiting position group aggregations.
- **Recruiting Transfer Portal** (read-only): Retrieve transfer portal entries for a given season.
- **Returning Production by Team** (read-only): Fetch Bill Connelly–style returning production splits by team and season.
- **Season Types Dictionary** (read-only): List season types.
